page.layout: One printed page: title page. Top: title in capitals and italics, centred; in the middle a woodcut ornament (no text); below it the imprint, centred.

main_text.l: Ad Vencislaum Lauinium ab Ottenfeld, Morauum.

page.notes: Woodcut ornament in the centre of the page, no text. Long s rendered as s throughout. The printed imprint reads "Anno 1585" with old-style figures; given as printed in Arabic numerals as they appear. Title lines 1-3 are set in spaced capitals; "Vencislaum", "Morauum" as printed.
